details.label: Extended Outlook
details.text: Saturday through Thursday. Though timing and path of thunderstorm clusters could change, latest model guidance suggests one such cluster crosses the area overnight Saturday into Sunday, with additional rounds of storms possible later that day. Flash flooding is the main risk with a lower probability of isolated instances of damaging wind.
